newsitem.title: UK: BTR shares pulled lower by profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: BTR shares pulled lower by profit-taking.

text.p: Shares in industrial conglomerate BTR Plc fell on Thursday as investors sold the stock to lock in profits after a strong run, dealers said.
The shares were 7-1/2p weaker at 269-1/2 at 1407 GMT, on volume of 7.8 million.
In the past two weeks the shares have risen more than fifty pence, climbing as high as 290-1/2 on Tuesday.
"They've had an exceptionally strong run in the last couple of weeks and got to 290, which was an important resistance level," one dealer said. "Some people have decided it's time to take profits."
